conditions.d4rt_uv_xyz: D4RT-predicted future UV and XYZ; camera path only
conditions.d4rt_uv_only: D4RT-predicted future UV with last valid XYZ repeated
conditions.affine_2d: robust 2-D partial affine fitted from the last two observed sparse UV frames
conditions.homography_2d: robust 2-D homography fitted from the last two observed sparse UV frames
conditions.raft_small_2d: pretrained torchvision RAFT-Small flow from the last two RGB frames, linearly extrapolated

meta.path_variants: all motion-source conditions use the frozen camera-only renderer
